think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s domain and documented valid range. 2) Check whether any numeric value (commonly -1 or 0) is documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/enable a feature, use ‘auto’, unlimited). 3) If such a mode-switching sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s). 4) Otherwise, treat it as a regular numeric knob whose values preserve natural ordering semantics (larger/smaller just changes magnitude of the same behavior).
